deviations.what: check_dev_accounts_absent (fairdm.E501) resolves the resolved environment itself inside the check function, unlike check_portal_roles_present (fairdm.E500), which leaves all environment gating to FairDMConfig._check_production_configuration()'s boot-time stand-down.
deviations.why: T028's acceptance criterion requires a development portal to report nothing even when `manage.py check --deploy` is run explicitly, which bypasses the boot-time stand-down entirely. Copying check_portal_roles_present's shape verbatim would report fairdm.E501 against a correctly-populated development portal the moment `check --deploy` runs on it by hand - the opposite of what the check exists to catch.

deviations.what: An existing Person on one of the five addresses is treated as create_dev_accounts' own account from a prior run (safe, idempotent no-op) only when its first_name/last_name match the specification's table for that address exactly; any other existing holder fails the whole run (wrapped in one transaction.atomic()) rather than being adopted.
deviations.why: Nothing is stored on Person to record which command created it, and adding a marker field would need a migration, which is prohibited for this story. The five addresses are on fairdm.org, a domain no genuine account would organically hold, so a name mismatch is a strong, cheap signal that something other than this command put the row there.
